recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-7503. If future work wants to constrain or clarify use of List for laboratory grouping, handle that under the separate OO lab grouping issues or a new FHIR-I tracker rather than reopening this applied DSTU1 request.
issue_request: FHIR-7503 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core List change request from the DSTU1 ballot asking whether nested lists were covered; the accepted resolution was to add a note about how to do lists of lists.
initial_application: Git commit e1936257b0cdeea11828989b9b5fa1f324d101a9 (#7503 - add note about nested lists) applied the change on 2015-06-26 with git-svn revision 5597, matching the Jira application comment. Later QA edits preserved the note and streamlined it to the current wording.
additional_context: List is active in source/fhir.ini, the current source/list/list-introduction.xml says Lists may contain other Lists to create a nested collection of Lists, and source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml defines List.entry.item as Reference(Resource). Community searches found no FHIR-7503-specific reversal; a 2026 OO lab grouping minutes page quoted the current note while discussing separate lab grouping issues.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current build-scope source already implements the requested note and the conformance definition allows a List entry to reference another List resource.
